propositions: Local shell/session/worktree writes on this machine are unsigned because no persistent signing_key is configured globally or per-machine.
The Rebar Bot identity (594c-9dcf-5ad6-4e6d) with email joeoakhart+bot@navapbc.com and a registered ed25519 public key already exists and is resolvable by git email fallback.

A persistent machine-wide signing key must be provisioned by materializing the private key from AWS SSM SecureString /rebar/prod/rebar-bot-signing-key to ~/.ssh/rebar-bot-signing-key with mode 0600, then configuring [identity] signing_key in ~/.config/rebar/config.toml.
Fresh worktrees and shells on this machine must sign with the configured key automatically without per-session setup.
The materialized private key's public half must match the public key registered on identity 594c-9dcf-5ad6-4e6d for signature verification to succeed.
